title: Needs/provides alias table — two notations, one object, with receipts
rule: NO ALIAS WITHOUT A RECEIPT. An entry may be added only for a documented case in which the same repository object demonstrably lived under two surface notations, and every entry cites the artifact pair that proved the synonymy. Receipts are verified byte-level on every gate run; if a receipt file loses its notation, the gate goes red rather than silently keeping the alias. An alias is a JOIN equivalence (a need naming either form is answerable by supply naming the other); it is never by itself a mathematical identity claim.

aliases.kind: case-variant notation for the same source object: the space of base metrics as the declared second argument of the source action I^B_1
aliases.documented_failure: BD-C (2026-08-15): a 2026-08-09 source re-inspection recorded 'metric variation | explicit through MET(X)' while two independent routes (OT-1, LA-11) called that leg unsupplied six days later — the supply was on file under the other casing and nobody joined them.

aliases.kind: transcription variants of ONE spoken chain node in the source transcript ('s u three comma two' vs 'spin three comma two'); the Spin form makes the chain group-theoretically impossible (dim Spin(3,2) = 10 < 12 = dim SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1))
aliases.documented_failure: SC-A (2026-08-15): the correct arrow-1 object SU(3,2) had been in ~20 files since 2026-07-06 while three sites (explorations/wave14/H19-seven-seven-signature-branch-2026-07-11.md:114,157 and successors) carried the impossible Spin(3,2) variant — one token apart, never joined.
aliases.join_only_note: Spin(3,2) and SU(3,2) are DIFFERENT groups; the equivalence is philological (same spoken object, adjudicated reconstruction SU(3,2) per LA-7 §1.4 and SC-A), so a need written against either surface form is answerable by supply about the adjudicated object.

aliases.kind: glyph variants (ASCII 'Pi' vs Greek capital pi) of the same object: the physical Rarita-Schwinger projector, which the repository records as not existing
aliases.documented_failure: Measured at FX-1 introduction (2026-08-16): 132 files carry the ASCII form and 29 the Greek form; lab/process/CURRENT-RESEARCH-CONTEXT.md carries BOTH for the same nonexistent projector (lines 1020 vs 2942-2952), so an exact join without this entry would treat the two populations as different objects.
